BurstDef.description: The particles a projectile of the look bursts into where it hits, spread over its splash.

count.description: How many at once, at most 24.
count.title: Count

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:shard (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

BurstDef.title: BurstDef

SwirlDef.description:
The particles that swirl in toward a projectile of the look while it forms in a caster's hands, spawned by
the clients; a ``hands`` forming shows them alone.

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:mote (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

per_tick.description: How many a tick while the cast runs, at most 8; times its particle's longest life, at most 80.
per_tick.title: Per Tick

SwirlDef.title: SwirlDef

TrailDef.description: The particles a projectile of the look leaves behind as it flies, spawned by its clients.

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:mote (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

per_block.description: How many a block flown, at most 3.
per_block.title: Per Block

TrailDef.title: TrailDef

description: An element's look, shared by every spell of it: frost reads as frost on Frostbolt and on Ice Lance.

burst.description: What its projectiles burst into where they hit.

colors.description: Its colours, lightest first, "#RRGGBB": each particle takes one at random, and its placeholder material is noise in them. At most 16.
colors.title: Colors

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

impact_sound.description: The sound event of its projectiles' hit on a block or a creature, e.g. minecraft:block.glass.break. A spell may name its own (visuals.impact_sound).
impact_sound.title: Impact Sound

light.description: How its models are lit. world: by the light where they are, like an arrow. glow: a few light levels above that, lighting nothing (frost). emit: at full brightness (fire); it lights its surroundings once the pack has dynamic lights (ADR 0075).
light.title: Light

swirl.description: What swirls in toward its projectile while it forms in a caster's hands (the storm of a grow or storm forming, and all a hands forming shows).

trail.description: What its projectiles leave behind in flight.

title: SpellLookDef
